email_body:
Hello Aaron,

I'm applying for the Civil Engineer / Design Engineer role at Newton Denny Chapelle that I saw on SEEK.

In February 2026 I finished an Advanced Diploma of Civil Construction Design, where I designed and documented road geometry, earthworks, pavement and stormwater drainage in Civil 3D and AutoCAD. I also hold a Bachelor of Science in Civil Engineering from the Philippines (2019), and from 2019 to 2020 I worked on site there as a field engineer and project-in-charge, including subdivision finishing works.

Your advert lists subdivision, road design, stormwater and civil documentation alongside your planning and surveying teams, which is the mix I want to learn in. I'm based in Melton VIC and open to discussing relocation to the Northern Rivers, with full working rights to December 2027 on a 485 visa. My design work so far is from study rather than a consultancy, so I would start at junior level.

I've attached my resume and cover letter. Could we arrange a time to talk?

Kind regards,
Marc Darenz Masarate

paragraphs: I am applying for the Civil Engineer / Design Engineer role advertised on SEEK. Urban development, road design, stormwater and civil documentation delivered alongside planning and surveying teams is the kind of work I want to start my design career in.

You asked what project experience I would bring. The most relevant is my Advanced Diploma of Civil Construction Design, finished in February 2026 at Albright Institute in Australia, where I designed and documented road geometry, earthworks, pavement and stormwater drainage in AutoCAD and Civil 3D to Australian Standards, and lodged Before You Dig Australia enquiries to design around existing services. On site in the Philippines in 2019 and 2020, as a field engineer on residential subdivision finishing works, I kept site reports and material records and coordinated with engineers, subcontractors and suppliers.

In my first three months I could help with drawing updates, quantities and technical reports, and with construction phase records, while learning your standards and the councils you work with. I also hold a Bachelor of Science in Civil Engineering from the Philippines (2019).

I have full working rights to December 2027 on a Subclass 485 visa, an Australian driver's licence and a White Card. I am based in Melton VIC and open to discussing relocation to the Northern Rivers. My design experience is from study rather than a consultancy, so I would start at junior level.
I have attached my resume and would welcome the chance to talk about the role.
